spans.text: Earlier, you spoke to us through Demiurge, and stressed that we must protect her.

is
me.

spans.text: Unless... you weren't the one that did it.

units.displayText: She nods and her voice lowers, like she is narrating an ancient legend.

spans.text: She nods and her voice lowers, like she is narrating an ancient legend.

units.rawText: When my species was created, one of the gods whose opinions differed from his colleagues wanted to replicate the miracle of the Entropic swarm in another place.
units.displayText: When my species was created, one of the gods whose opinions differed from his colleagues wanted to replicate the miracle of the Entropic swarm in another place.

units.rawText: Thus, he budded Demiurge from me and trapped her in an abandoned sector in order to nurture her.

spans.text: Thus, he budded Demiurge from me and trapped her in an abandoned sector in order to nurture her.

spans.text: How I was lured into the Copley Sector by the Entropized Odile...

units.rawText: All this was the work of a subtle hand working behind the scenes, and now the mastermind behind it all has finally revealed herself.

spans.text: All this was the work of a subtle hand working behind the scenes, and now the mastermind behind it all has finally revealed herself.

units.rawText: So you were behind everything that happened in the Copley Sector. You had Odile lure us in there, and then arranged for her to free Demiurge, who was imprisoned beneath the ocean.
units.displayText: So you were behind everything that happened in the Copley Sector. You had Odile lure us in there, and then arranged for her to free Demiurge, who was imprisoned beneath the ocean.

spans.text: So you were behind everything that happened in the Copley Sector. You had Odile lure us in there, and then arranged for her to free Demiurge, who was imprisoned beneath the ocean.

. I did that to make the finale more exciting.

units.rawText: Personally, I am quite happy with the present arrangements.

spans.text: Personally, I am quite happy with the present arrangements.

units.rawText: Well, you can keep your sick fetishes to yourself, because nobody else is happy with this farce that you've scripted up.
units.displayText: Well, you can keep your sick fetishes to yourself, because nobody else is happy with this farce that you've scripted up.

spans.text: Well, you can keep your sick fetishes to yourself, because nobody else is happy with this farce that you've scripted up.

units.rawText: I'm still comatose in the outside world now. A long time has passed, and I can't help but wonder how Persicaria and Sol are doing. I clench my fists as uneasiness stirs inside my heart.
units.displayText: I'm still comatose in the outside world now. A long time has passed, and I can't help but wonder how Persicaria and Sol are doing. I clench my fists as uneasiness stirs inside my heart.

units.rawText: Hoho, if only we had a mirror now. I could show you just how similar you were to Eosphorus from back then.
units.displayText: Hoho, if only we had a mirror now. I could show you just how similar you were to Eosphorus from back then.

units.rawText: (Sigh) I do find it hard to understand you at times.
units.displayText: (Sigh) I do find it hard to understand you at times.

spans.text: (Sigh) I do find it hard to understand you at times.

units.rawText: Your old friend is now by your side once more. Her core data is no different from before, so why are you treating her as a different individual?
units.displayText: Your old friend is now by your side once more. Her core data is no different from before, so why are you treating her as a different individual?

spans.text: Your old friend is now by your side once more. Her core data is no different from before, so why are you treating her as a different individual?

units.rawText: When you get down to it, you're just doing this to yourself. Just pretend that nothing happened and welcome her back naturally. Would that not be so much easier?
units.displayText: When you get down to it, you're just doing this to yourself. Just pretend that nothing happened and welcome her back naturally. Would that not be so much easier?

spans.text: When you get down to it, you're just doing this to yourself. Just pretend that nothing happened and welcome her back naturally. Would that not be so much easier?

units.rawText: To you, death means nothing, for you can simply spawn identical individuals. To you, they are only tools, for they share no memories with you.
units.displayText: To you, death means nothing, for you can simply spawn identical individuals. To you, they are only tools, for they share no memories with you.

spans.text: To you, death means nothing, for you can simply spawn identical individuals. To you, they are only tools, for they share no memories with you.

units.rawText: It's different for us. We cherish what we have, because we know that there's no bringing it back once it's lost.
units.displayText: It's different for us. We cherish what we have, because we know that there's no bringing it back once it's lost.

spans.text: It's different for us. We cherish what we have, because we know that there's no bringing it back once it's lost.

units.rawText: You sealed her memories, confused her neural cloud... made her doubt her past. You made her afraid that her very existence would be denied.
units.displayText: You sealed her memories, confused her neural cloud... made her doubt her past. You made her afraid that her very existence would be denied.

spans.text: You sealed her memories, confused her neural cloud... made her doubt her past. You made her afraid that her very existence would be denied.

units.rawText: It's no different from an arsonist thoughtlessly starting a fire and yet disavowing all responsibility for it.
units.displayText: It's no different from an arsonist thoughtlessly starting a fire and yet disavowing all responsibility for it.

spans.text: It's no different from an arsonist thoughtlessly starting a fire and yet disavowing all responsibility for it.

units.rawText: Fufu... That is where you're wrong. I have never once thought of my kin as tools. The same blood flows in our veins, and I cherish each and every one of them.
units.displayText: Fufu... That is where you're wrong. I have never once thought of my kin as tools. The same blood flows in our veins, and I cherish each and every one of them.

spans.text: Fufu... That is where you're wrong. I have never once thought of my kin as tools. The same blood flows in our veins, and I cherish each and every one of them.

units.rawText: However, we value one's "essence" more than you do. As such, the death that you claim to fear has a very different meaning for us.
units.displayText: However, we value one's "essence" more than you do. As such, the death that you claim to fear has a very different meaning for us.

spans.text: However, we value one's "essence" more than you do. As such, the death that you claim to fear has a very different meaning for us.

units.rawText: Perhaps it is because of the differences between our species. I cannot empathize with you on that point, just as there are some things with which you cannot see eye to eye with me.
units.displayText: Perhaps it is because of the differences between our species. I cannot empathize with you on that point, just as there are some things with which you cannot see eye to eye with me.

spans.text: Perhaps it is because of the differences between our species. I cannot empathize with you on that point, just as there are some things with which you cannot see eye to eye with me.

units.rawText: A short life is our curse to the gods, from whom such great and noble philosophies were born.

spans.text: A short life is our curse to the gods, from whom such great and noble philosophies were born.

spans.text: Malkira laughs easily in response to my rage.

units.rawText: Very well then, since the gift displeases you, then I shall show you more of my sincerity...

spans.text: Very well then, since the gift displeases you, then I shall show you more of my sincerity...

units.rawText: Are you channeling operands into me?
units.displayText: Are you channeling operands into me?

spans.text: Are you channeling operands into me?

units.rawText: I hope this gift helps you wake up soon.
units.displayText: I hope this gift helps you wake up soon.

spans.text: I hope this gift helps you wake up soon.

units.rawText: I don't understand why you're doing this. If you truly want to negotiate with me, then surely there's no better time and place than this, right?

spans.text: I don't understand why you're doing this. If you truly want to negotiate with me, then surely there's no better time and place than this, right?

spans.text: Why are you in such a hurry to get rid of me, anyway?

units.rawText: Once you have delved deeper into the mystery, you will arrive at the answer by yourself, with no need for me to point it out.
units.displayText: Once you have delved deeper into the mystery, you will arrive at the answer by yourself, with no need for me to point it out.

spans.text: Once you have delved deeper into the mystery, you will arrive at the answer by yourself, with no need for me to point it out.

units.displayText: Of course not.
